summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics (formerly Galapagos NV) filed a 6-K reporting H1 2026 results, announcing a $50 million share repurchase program initiated June 9, 2026, with Morgan Stanley & Co. International PLC, expected completion by December 31, 2026. As of June 30, 241,904 shares repurchased at average price €25.1261, held as treasury shares. Company maintains year-end 2026 cash guidance of ~$2 billion, with at least $1.6 billion dry powder after funding portfolio to first gamgertamig approval. Also completed Ouro Medicines acquisition with Gilead. Watch: pace of buyback execution and potential strategic transactions using excess cash.
